card.name: After Clostridium difficile diarrhea phrase
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis right after 'Clostridium difficile associated diarrhea', just before the abbreviation CDAD. Also the word 'for' after 'antibacterial drug treatment' when CDI follows.

modes.label: Parenthesis before CDAD
modes.description: The '(' that follows the full phrase 'Clostridium difficile associated diarrhea' in warning text.

modes.label: For before CDI
modes.description: The word 'for' linking antibacterial treatment to the infection abbreviation CDI.
modes.example: Administer ZINPLAVA during antibacterial drug treatment<< for>> CDI. 2.2 D
